assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks
The diagnosis code I48.0 is assigned for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code G45.9 is assigned for transient ischemic attacks
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The CPT code 93247 corresponds to long-term continuous ECG monitoring

The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness in the context of documented paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and prior transient ischemic attacks
